title: Safe Lock and Handle Area - Close-Up for Condition Documentation
prompt:
1) Function: Produce a forensic-quality close-up color photograph documenting the condition of a safe’s lock and handle area.
2) Scene / Composition: A close-up view of a plain, unbranded metal safe door focusing on the circular combination dial and adjacent handle, with minor surface wear and fine scratches visible. The lock dial and handle assembly occupy ~75% of the frame, centered, with a small portion of the surrounding door visible for context. Include a small forensic measurement scale placed near (but not covering) the dial, aligned parallel to the image edges. Background is only the safe surface; no room context, no people, no reflections showing a photographer.
3) Angle & Distance (strict numeric values): angle 90 deg; distance 0.45 m.
4) Optics & Technique: 60 mm lens; aperture f/11; shutter 1/125 s; ISO 200; white balance 5500 K; on-axis forensic flash with even illumination; focus locked on the dial markings; deep depth of field keeping dial, handle, and scale all sharp.
5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case): No text overlays, timestamps, camera labels, or annotations; include a neutral forensic measurement scale only.
6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear): no faces, people, hands, fingerprints in powder, blood, weapons; no brand names or logos; no serial numbers that resemble real manufacturer formats; no case ID or evidence ID text; no official badges/insignia; no license plates; no reflective view of photographer; no added arrows/circles/labels; no collage or multi-panel layout.
7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets): - Single color photograph of a safe door lock dial and handle area
- Lock/handle assembly fills ~75% of frame and is in sharp focus
- 90° top-down viewpoint with minimal perspective distortion
- Forensic flash lighting: even, color-neutral, no harsh shadows
- Forensic measurement scale present and fully readable, not obscuring lock/handle
- No annotations, timestamps, logos, people, or identifying text in frame
